description: This file implements a Jira connector class (`JiraConnector`) for integrating with Atlassian Jira APIs. It provides methods for authentication, searching issues, creating issues, and retrieving metadata about Jira projects. It serves as a skeleton or stub implementation, with detailed docstrings and method signatures, but lacks full API integration logic.

classes.name: JiraConnector
classes.description: Implements a connector for managing Jira issues and metadata, supporting OAuth and API key authentication strategies.

methods.name: ConnectorDescriptor descriptor(self)
methods.description: Returns metadata about the Jira connector, including supported auth strategies, capabilities, and documentation URLs.

methods.name: List[AuthStrategy] auth_strategies(self)
methods.description: Returns a list of supported authentication strategies for this connector (OAuth and API Key).

methods.name: Dict[str,str] apply_auth(self, headers: Dict[str, str], *, auth: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Applies the specified authentication method to request headers, supporting OAuth and API key strategies.

methods.name: SearchResponse search(self, req: SearchRequest)
methods.description: Stub for executing Jira issue searches based on a query, returning a simplified search result with one example item.

methods.name: CreateResponse create(self, req: CreateRequest)
methods.description: Stub for creating Jira issues, returning a minimal response with a dummy issue ID and URL.

methods.name: MetadataResponse metadata(self, req: MetadataRequest)
methods.description: Returns metadata about Jira projects; for other resources, returns an empty list.
